_about: All game text. Addresses: PSI5/SEL = DS offset in the snapshot; files = byte offset. "\n" = CR (0x0d, line break). codeRefs = functions using the address as operand (PSI5: re/psi5.lst; SEL: web/src/sel.js), ptrSlots = DS words pointing at it, ptrUsers = functions referencing a table that contains such a word. See docs/modern/model/data.md.

 your ship has been fully stocked with
 enough fuel, food, and supplies for
 your journey.  Your crew is on board
 and have taken their positions in
 preparation for departure.  I wish you
 the best of luck and may the solar
 winds of Xaldur be in your favor.
            Sincerely, Admiral Lorenzen
            STAR BASE 27 COMMAND

Captain,
     Your orders are to select a course
 and cargo from the list below.
 Intelligence reports show an increase
 in space pirate activity in most
 sectors of the Parvin Frontier.  The
 mission rewards reflect the amount of
 relative danger and risk for each

 prompt delivery of perishable cargo.

 select one candidate (out of six) to
 fill each crew position for the five
 departments.
                  ...Good Luck!

messages.text:
Sighted enemy target.  Engaged and
 destroyed, sir.

Reporting all requested firing orders
 have been accomplished.

Be advised that I have engaged a
 target of opportunity.

Pirates have gotten aboard!  Get those
 thieves!

Pirates chewed up the cargo area
 pretty bad!  We'd better keep on our
 toes.  Can't have this happen again!

Missile system damaged!  It works but
 I have to have more power!

Guidance gyro in missile weapon
 must be repaired or the system is
 useless!

Missile weapon system has been 
 completely destroyed!

I need more power, sir!  Blaster has
 been damaged!

Immediate repairs on the blaster
 are necessary!  It is broken!

Blaster weapon system has been reduced
 to space dust!  NEED HELP!

Damaged cannon weapon system.
 Functions but I need more power, sir!

Breech blocks frozen!  Cannon system
 useless until repair completed!

Cannon weapon system melted.  Now a
 giant pile of space junk!

Damage to thermo weapon system!  More
 power please!

Thermo weapon system broken!  Reactor
 rods melted!  Useless until fixed!
Meltdown!  Thermo damaged!  System
Anxy, Repairs
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
All assigned tasks have been completed
 as you requested, sir.

Although you didn't request it, I took
 the opportunity to start working on
 some items which needed repair.

Those dirty pirates are stealing our
 cargo!

The pirates are leaving!  I hope we
 still have some cargo to deliver!

Robodroid two is out of action until
 we can get him fixed!

Robodroid two has been hit again!  He
 is in worse shape!

Robodroid two was just blown to
 smithereens!

Robodroid five can't function until we
 get him repaired!

They shot robodroid five again.  Now
 it'll take much more time to fix him!

Oh, no!  Robodroid five has just been
 blasted into space dust!

Robodroid seven is damaged and can no
 longer function until fixed!

Robodroid seven just got clobbered
 again!

We need to give robodroid seven
 last rites.  If only he had a soul.
Mr.Skump, Navigation
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
Evasive manuverink iz impossible
 because retros don't verk properly

Ve are unable tu change course tu port
 since da starboard retro iz broke.

Ve are unable tu change course tu 
 starboard, since da port retro iz not
 vurking.

Ve must be careful since ve are now
 enterink a sector vit much reported
 pirate acttivity.
Ve iz startink evasive manuvrink.

I be vuried bout me life support
 system.  Iz braken und not vurkink
 vell.  Pleez inform repair at yur
 urleust kunvenyunz.  Tanku.

Me life support system kent support me
 life much longur......Pleez tell dose
 lagards in repair tu vake up!

Dem pirate scum hav started lootink.
 Pleez tell repair to hurry so ve can
 still salvage sum uv our cargo.

Doz pirates are leavink.  I hope der
 iz enuf cargo left to make dis trip
 vorth finishink vit sum bonus.

Engine vun iz not vurkink tu good and 
 needs sum fixink.
Engine vun don't vurk at all!

Engine vun iz broke tu bad tu be
 fixed!

Engine two need sum repair kuz it not 
 vurkink tu good.
Engine two iz broke.
Engine two iz destroyed by blast.
Retro on port zide iz not responsiv.

Pleez tell repair dat de port retro
 kwit vurkink.

Port retro haz bin turned into lump uv
 melted metal!
Starboard retro not vurkink vell.

Retro on starboard side not vurkink at 
 all.

Starboard retro haz bin destroyed.
 Vat du ve do now?
Blustan, Scanning

messages.text:
Some cargo has been shot up!  There
 goes my lunch!

Looting has begun!  Oh, stars!  Let's
 try and get 'em!

The vultures are finally gone!  I
 recognized some of those thieves from
 my college days!

Heads up!  Danger approaching,...
 philosophically speaking!

Computers indicate cargo is beginning
 to spoil.  Lets get going!

Requested examinations completed!
 That's all, folks!  OK to proceed,
 sir.

I just thought I'd check out a few
 things, sir!

Information scanner is barely working,
 sir!  Call repair!

Doesn't look good!  Info scanner is
 inoperative!  Need help.  NOW!

Info scan is gone!  My enthusiasm is
 dampening, sir!

Call repair!  Without our tracking
 lock system we're candidates for the
 space grave!

Tracking system is broken!  Need
 repair immediately!

Tracking system melted!  Time to will
 my spacely goods to my pet skork!
Cargo environment sys. took a hit!

Cargo environment sys. really looks
 bad!  Help!

Cargo is in trouble!  Environment sys.
 is useless!

Stabilization unit in cargo is
 damaged!  Where in heck is repair?

Cargo in trouble!  No stabilization.
 Get that bucket of bolts from repair
 down here!

No stabilization!  That's it for the
 cargo!
Boris, Weapons
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
Bingo!  Another target destroyed.  I
 love the smell of melted metal!

Firing tasks complete.  I'm just
 waiting for those skorkies to try
 something.  I'll nail 'em!

It comes naturally for me to react
 well in combat!  You can count on
 me.  I love combat!

We've got to get them!  We can't lose
 our cargo!

Let's go after them!  Those dogs!
 Make 'em eat space dirt!

I am taking more power to work the
 damaged missile system

I need one of those robodroids on the
 missile system!  NOW!  This thing is
 broken!

Missile system useless!  Get the trash
 out of here.

Give me more power!  Blaster damaged!
 It's a pig to fire!  We're vulnerable.

That's it!  Blaster is inoperable.
 Get someone up here now!

Blaster blown!  There're nothing but
 jerks around here!

Cannon weapon malfunction.  I've got
 to have power!

Where are those stupid robodroids?
 I can't use the cannon at all.
Cannon melted!  Jerks!

Thermo weapon system damaged!  It's
 going to require more power to
 function

Our goose is cooked!  Thermo is
 broken.  Get it fixed!

Thermo weapon system blown to bits!
 Not a bit left to salvage.
Bronx, Navigation
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
I can't manage evasive maneuvering
 because of our malfunctioning retros

I'm unable to change course to port.
 Starboard retro is not working, sir.

Starboard course change impossible!
 Our port retro is broken!

We should not enter this quadrant of
 the galaxy.  It is a very risky area!
Hold on!  I'm taking evasive action!

I'm a little worried about my life
 support...I'm getting light headed
 ......sir!

Please!  My life support is not 
 working properly.  It's becoming very 
 hard to maneuver!  Please!

My stars!  I can't believe it.  We're
 being looted!  I really did try to 
 maneuver the best I could!

I'm so sorry!  Are we all right?  At
 least the looters have left!

There's a problem with engine one!
 Get repair to look into it please.

Engine one is badly damaged!  Sir,
 could you please get us some help!

Engine one is useless.  It's blasted!
 I don't know how long I can maintain
 our current situation.

Engine two is starting to fail, sir!
 Please call repair ASAP!

Engine two is now nonfunctional!
 HELP!

This is terrible!  Engine two is 
 completely burned out!

The port retro is acting up, sir.  I
 think it's damaged!
Our port retro is not functional!

Oh!..This is terrible!  Port retro is 
 gone!

Oh!  It looks like the starboard retro
 has been damaged!

I can't keep the starboard retro going
 and I can't seem to steer.
Oh, no!  Starboard retro is useless!
Bru, Repairs
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
Hey, up there, I've done my usual
 great job!  Now what?

You should pay me more!  Do I always
 have to take the initiative to fix
 everything around here?

Get those looters out!  Where is our
 defense around here?

Those looters are gone but they sure
 left a mess down in cargo.

Robodroid two is damaged!  I'll have
 to pull him off the line!

We've taken a hit in the department!
 Robodroid two got hit again!

I'm sorry to say, but robodroid two
 is useless.

We've got a problem.  Robodroid five
 is damaged and unable to work!

Oh!  Now robodroid five has been hit
 again.  He's in bad shape!

Robodroid five has been completely
 destroyed.

One of our best robos, robo seven, has
 had a malfunction caused by a hit!

Robo seven has taken a second hit from
 enemy fire!

I'm sorry, but we could not save
 robodroid seven.  He's gone, sir.
Bru, Repairs

messages.text:
Those space scum have destroyed some
 of our precious cargo!  Get them!

Those pirate scum have boarded and are
 getting away with our cargo!

Whew!  They're gone.  I hope they left
 some cargo!

An unidentified craft is entering our
 scanning range.

Sniff, sniff...Hey I think we better
 hurry.  The cargo is getting ripe!

I've completed the examination of all 
 the ships you requested.

I believed that it was necessary to 
 commence an examination on my own.
Info scanner has been damaged!

Please tell repair to take a look at
 our broken info scanner!

The info scanner has just melted
 down!
The tracking lock system is flakey!

Tell repair that the tracking lock
 system has failed!

Tracking lock system has been blasted
 to pieces!

The cargo environment sys. is damaged
 and requires attention!

We are in danger of losing our cargo
 if its environment sys. isn't fixed!

Our cargo environment sys. has been
 destroyed!  Run for it!

I've just noticed some damage to our
 cargo stabilization unit.

Cargo stabilization unit is broken and 
 needs fixing!

The cargo stabilization unit has been
 destroyed!
Craven, Engineering

messages.text:
Hurry...please...my life support!!
 I only have one life up here!

Please get someone in repair to look
 at my life support system!  Please!!

Here come the south side looters!
 They look real nasty.

Those astrolooters are so dumb.  They
 went for the Cravenlator and left
 behind some cargo!

Only half power on reactor one.  Get
 robos on it.  We need the power.

Reactor one is broken and must be
 repaired immediately!
She's going!..Reactor one meltdown!

We can operate reactor two only at
 half power.  Send repair ASAP!

We're vulnerable!  Reactor two is
 useless if not repaired soon, sir!

We just lost reactor two!  Blown to
 microdust!

My life support system has been
 damaged and is malfunctioning.

I'm in real trouble down here!  My
 life support system is cutting out!!
 It's broken!

Oh stardust!  My life support unit is
 in a puddle.

Navigator's life support system has
 been damaged!!  Send some help!

Someone has got to get help to the
 navigator!  The life support is
 broken!  Someone has to fly this ship!

Navigator will soon be gone!  What
 will we do?

Cravenlator is damaged!  No telling
 what will happen next!

This Cravenlator is just as useless
 working as not!  Now it's not
Cravenlator has been destroyed!
Fligronk, Engineering
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
You've got to fix my life support!  I 
 don't want to die!

I'm strongly requesting that someone,
 PLEASE, fix my life support system.

Who's running the show?...The looters
 have boarded!

I'm glad that we showed them!  Dirty
 astro scum!  They're gone!
Reactor one damaged, sir.

Reactor one inoperable, sir.  Request
 repair immediately.

Reactor one is a pile of space scrap!
 I'm tired of incompetence!

Sir, reactor two has been damaged.
 She might hold together.

Reactor two can't last!  She's
 breaking up!
Reactor two...vaporized!

Get someone up here from repair!  My
 life support unit is cutting out.

This is critical...my life support
 is broken.

My life support unit was blown up.
 I'm a goner now!

Navigator's life support unit is having
 periodic failures!  Fetch repair.

Navigator's life support inoperative.
 Send help fast!

There is nothing left of navigator's
 life support unit.  He is a goner!

I don't even want to mention this but
 the Cravenlator is broken!

Well, we've really gotten lucky!  NOW
 the Cravenlator doesn't work at all!
...Trashed...Cravenlator!
Grolo, Weapons
usedBy: f_657f: title line under every message

messages.text:
Enemy destroyed, sir.  Oh...darn good
 shot, if I may say so.

All firing missions completed.  I'm
 hungry.  Anyone got a NovaSpace
 burger?

I interrupted my snack to start
 shooting at a target of opportunity.

Pirates in the cargo bay!  Stop them
 or they will steal the Astro cookies!

Succeeded in running off space pirates
 I jumped 'em with all four paws.

Missile weapon damaged!  Sir, I need
 increased power to fire!

Missile system broken!  I can't hit
 the broad side of a space barn!

Missile weapon system has been
 vaporized!  System is totally gone!

Blaster system damaged!  Need more
 power and....my moon bars.

Blaster useless.  Broken!  Get some
 help, sir!
Blaster has been blown to smithereens!

Cannon weapon damaged!  Oh, there are
 traces of a Choco Dud bar fouling
 things up!

Broken gear renders cannon weapon
 useless until repairs are made!

Cannon weapon system blown from the 
 ship to the junk yard in the sky!

Thermo weapon system damaged!  Toasted
 marshmallows, anyone?...

Thermo weapon broken!  Glad I started
 my day with Galaxy Flakes!

Thermo weapon system destroyed.
 Totally awesome!
Jaru, Scanning

Those scum are beginning to loot our
 cargo!  Let's do something!

I'm relieved the scum are finally

Unidentified spacecraft rapidly
 approaching our area, sir!

Get us going.  The cargo is rotting

Examinations complete.  Lucky you have

I've initiated alien ship examination,
 sir.

Information scanner damaged by enemy
 fire!  Sir, call repair!

Info scanner is as useless as most
 men!

Information scanner vaporized by enemy

Tracking lock system hit, sir!

Tracking system inoperable.  Prompt
 action required!

Tracking system obliterated!  Assume

Cargo environment sys. broken.  Must
 repair immediately!

Cargo environment annihilated!

 Incompetent men!

Stabilization unit in cargo area is 
 damaged!

Cargo stabilization unit is down.  We
 will need assistance, sir.

I warned you!  Those robodroids are
 incompetent too!  They did not even

 unit.

Low power thrust in retros.  Unable to
 employ evasive maneuvers!

Starboard retro broken!  Course
 changes to port impossible.

Port retro broken!  Course changes to
 starboard impossible!

We're entering a high risk quadrant!

I'm using evasive maneuvers.  Hang on,
 space cadets!

Having trouble with life support.  I
 feel a power drain.

Need help!!  Life support nearly gone!
 Internal vaccdroid systems are
 failing!

Space pirates removing our cargo, sir.
 Do something!

Pirate intruders have retreated.  I
 hope they're gone for good, sir.

Engine one damaged in pirate raid!
 will try to maintain speed!

Engine one broken!  Unusable until
 repaired.  Get a robodroid on it!

Engine one is unrepairable!  Sir,
 we've tried everything!

Engine two damaged.  Continuing as
 best we can, sir.

Engine two is useless until repairs
 can be completed.  Where are those
 robodroids?

Damage to engine two was too much!  It
 is gone!  Thats the last time we buy
 from a Rigelian used parts shop!
Port retro damaged.  We need help!

Port retro is broken.  Retro unusable
 until repairs are made!

Damage to the port retro was too much!

Starboard retro has been damaged.

Starboard retro is unusable.  Anyone
 have a monkey wrench?
Starboard retro has been destroyed.
